source_restatement: Let M be a Riemannian submanifold of a Euclidean space E with the metric induced by E, and let F:M→ℝ be smooth. Its Riemannian gradient is characterized by DF(x)[v]=⟨v,grad F(x)⟩x for every tangent vector v. For any smooth ambient neighborhood extension f of F, grad F(x)=Proj_x(grad f(x)). For the unit sphere the tangent space at x is the orthogonal complement of the line spanned by x.

theorem sphere_gradient_characterization
    (n : ℕ) [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ E = n + 1)]
    (x : sphere (0 : E) 1) {f : E → ℝ} {g : E}
    (hf : HasGradientAt f g (x : E)) :
    ∀ z : (ℝ ∙ (x : E))ᗮ,
      ((∀ w : TangentSpace (𝓡 n) x,
        mvfderiv (𝓡 n) (fun y : sphere (0 : E) 1 => f (y : E)) x w =
          ⟪mvfderiv (𝓡 n) ((↑) : sphere (0 : E) 1 → E) x w, (z : E)⟫_ℝ) ↔
        z = (ℝ ∙ (x : E))ᗮ.orthogonalProjectionOnto g)
